approved_write_scopes.rationale: Required solely to mint the short-lived OIDC signing identity for the ENG-06.4 native attestation transport probe.
Required solely to persist the signed ENG-06.4 transport probe in GitHub native artifact attestations.

invariants: inventory is offline and never executes workflows
changed workflows require explicit top-level permissions
read-all and write-all are forbidden in changed workflows
write scopes are denied unless an exact workflow path plus scope approval exists
job-level permissions cannot add a scope absent from the top-level mapping
dynamic or structurally ambiguous permissions fail closed in changed mode
legacy permission debt is reported without bulk rewriting historical workflows
deleted workflow files do not create stale-content failures
